message: No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local file paths; there is no remote source fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any file.

No detected label flipping detection: The code processes detection confidence scores and spatial grid data but never validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs spatial clustering and confidence-based filtering (removeOutlierClusters, dfs thresholds) for ROI extraction, but these are algorithmic processing steps rather than statistical anomaly checks or outlier detection aimed at defending against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads hyperparameters from JSON files and runs a detector via run_detector(), but there is no hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source enforcement on any pretrained weights or serialized model artifacts.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs detection, ROI finding, and clustering but contains no checks on label distribution, class balance, or expected label sets before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the provided code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or any DP mechanisms are used or imported in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The logging mechanism appends results to a plain JSON file with no hashing, signing, or isolation of evaluation data from training data to prevent metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and video paths directly without validating input shapes, ranges, or schemas before passing them to the detector or ROI functions.
No detected output bounds checks: Detection outputs and confidence scores are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation before downstream processing.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision pipeline (object detection/tracking), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
